item.title: What will it take for U.S. and Iran to end war? Here’s what we know.
item.summary: The sides are far apart on Iran’s nuclear program, the Strait of Hormuz and the Israeli campaign against Hezbollah in Lebanon.

item.title: Trump fumes as Iran retains choke hold on Strait of Hormuz ahead of peace talks
item.summary: In addition to stalled shipping, continued Israeli strikes in Lebanon are threatening the shaky ceasefire.

item.title: China helped broker Iran truce, but it’s wary of deeper involvement
item.summary: Beijing urged Iran to accept a ceasefire, but it hasn’t agreed to act as a guarantor of the deal in America’s messy war.

item.title: Israel to open direct talks with Lebanon but not halt attacks on Hezbollah
item.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced that his country was ready for direct negotiations amid international calls for Israel to stop its strikes in Lebanon.

item.title: After Trump pauses war, Iranians fly flags of victory, not surrender
item.summary: Amid fierce disagreements, the dramatic, last-minute decision to halt attacks seems less like an exit ramp than a rest stop for all sides.

item.title: U.S. negotiators to ask Iran to release detained Americans
item.summary: The request for the Americans’ release may be delayed if the talks between President Donald Trump’s team and Iran prove difficult, according to people briefed on the plans.

item.title: U.S. team heads to Iran peace talks with a gulf separating the two sides
item.summary: Amid allegations of bad faith and ceasefire violations from both Washington and Tehran, negotiators travel to Islamabad for high-stakes talks.

item.title: In Lebanon’s shelters, not everyone is welcome
item.summary: Those who are able head for second homes, move in with family or stay in hotels. Those who aren’t crowd into cramped shelters, stadiums or parking lots, or worse.

item.title: Tako? Takou? TACO-ru? Decoding the Trump TACO meme around the world.
item.summary: A Washington Post reporter’s doctor in Seoul had a question — how to translate “chicken out,” as in “Trump always chickens out,” into Korean?

item.title: First major Atlantic hurricane season outlook calls for below-average activity
item.summary: A developing “super El Niño” may reduce the number of storms in the Atlantic.
